checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-COLUMN-PROCESS: Data Column Sidecar Gossip Verification
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Identify the gossip verification handler for data column sidecars in the CL codebase. 2. Confirm that batched KZG commitment verification is performed BEFORE the column is accepted. 3. Confirm that inclusion proof verification is performed BEFORE the column is accepted. 4. Craft a data column sidecar with a valid KZG proof but invalid inclusion proof and verify rejection. 5. Craft a sidecar with valid inclusion proof but corrupted KZG commitment and verify rejection. 6. Verify that validation failure metrics are incremented on rejection.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-METRICS-PRECOND-002. Boundary edge EDGE-COLUMN-PROCESS from EXT-PEER-P2P-DATA-COLUMN to CL PeerDAS verification. Trust model: each sidecar must pass batched KZG + inclusion proof before acceptance.

checklist.title: Verify KZG batch verification rejects individually invalid commitments within a valid batch
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the batched KZG verification function. 2. Verify that a single invalid commitment in a batch of valid ones causes rejection of the invalid column (not the entire batch). 3. Confirm that the batch optimization does not allow individual invalid proofs to pass when aggregated.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-METRICS-PRECOND-002, node ACTION-VERIFY-KZG-BATCH. Supporting check for boundary integrity.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-START-VALIDATION: Block Header Timestamp Monotonicity
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the block header validation function that checks timestamps. 2. Verify that the implementation enforces timestamp > parent.timestamp (strict monotonicity). 3. Craft a block with timestamp == parent.timestamp and confirm rejection. 4. Craft a block with timestamp < parent.timestamp and confirm rejection. 5. Verify that blocks from untrusted P2P peers undergo this check before any further processing.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-HOMESTEAD-INV-006. Boundary edge EDGE-START-VALIDATION from EXT-PEER-VIA-P2P. Trust model: all peer data is potentially malicious, full header validation required.

checklist.title: Verify difficulty adjustment is protected against timestamp manipulation at boundary
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Trace the difficulty calculation function and its dependency on block timestamps. 2. Verify that the minimum timestamp increment prevents difficulty reduction attacks. 3. Check if there is an upper bound on future timestamps to prevent difficulty inflation.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-HOMESTEAD-INV-006, node ACTION-VALIDATE-HEADER. Supporting check for timestamp-dependent difficulty adjustment security.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-QUERY: Log Query Completeness Proof Enforcement
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the log query API handler (EIP-7919/EIP-7745 2D index). 2. Verify that every query response includes a completeness proof. 3. Attempt to request logs without proof generation and verify the system refuses or always includes proofs. 4. Verify that the completeness proof is cryptographically verifiable by light clients. 5. Test with a query that matches zero logs and verify the proof still demonstrates completeness.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP7919-PRECOND-002. Boundary edge EDGE-QUERY from EXT-LIGHT-CLIENT. Trust model: queries must include completeness proofs with bounded false-positive guarantees.

checklist.title: Verify log query DoS resistance for expensive queries at trust boundary
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Identify rate limiting or resource bounding for log query processing. 2. Craft a maximally expensive query (wide block range, common topic) and verify resource bounds. 3. Verify that query processing cannot block consensus-critical operations.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP7919-PRECOND-002, node ACTION-QUERY-LOGS. Trust model notes: system must handle expensive queries without DoS.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for Deposit Data Root: SSZ Hash Tree Root Comparison
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the deposit() function in the deposit contract. 2. Verify that deposit_data_root is computed via SSZ hash tree root of the DepositData object. 3. Verify that a mismatched deposit_data_root causes transaction revert. 4. Craft a deposit with correct parameters but wrong deposit_data_root and confirm revert. 5. Craft a deposit with tampered pubkey but matching (re-computed) deposit_data_root and verify acceptance.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-DEPOSIT-PRECOND-002. Boundary from EXT-DEPOSITOR-VIA-TX to Deposit Contract. Trust model: contract validates deposit_data_root integrity, minimum amount, parameter lengths.

checklist.title: Verify deposit parameter length validation at contract boundary
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Verify deposit contract enforces pubkey=48 bytes, withdrawal_credentials=32 bytes, signature=96 bytes. 2. Submit deposit with truncated pubkey (47 bytes) and verify revert. 3. Submit deposit with oversized signature (97 bytes) and verify revert.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-DEPOSIT-PRECOND-002, node STATE-CALLDATA-VALID. Supporting boundary check for parameter validation.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-RECEIVE-SIG: Validator Signature Verification with Self-Address
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the signature verification handler for EIP-7749 validator contracts. 2. Verify that the message is reconstructed using the validator's OWN address, not a user-supplied address. 3. Craft a valid signature intended for validator A and submit it to validator B; confirm rejection. 4. Verify ecrecover is used correctly: hash computation, v/r/s parameter handling. 5. Confirm that recovered signer address is compared against the expected signer.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP7749-PRECOND-002. Boundary edge EDGE-RECEIVE-SIG from EXT-SIGNATURE-PRESENTER. Trust model: validator must use own address for message reconstruction.

checklist.title: Verify address comparison is constant-time and uses canonical form
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Verify that address comparison uses a constant-time comparison or Solidity == (which is constant-time for fixed-size types). 2. Verify addresses are compared in canonical 20-byte form (no leading zero ambiguity).
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP7749-PRECOND-002, node ACTION-COMPARE-ADDRESSES. Supporting check for signature verification boundary.

checklist.title: Falsify metrics endpoint access control: attempt unauthenticated access to Prometheus metrics disclosing validator counts, sync state, and peer topology
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Identify the Prometheus metrics HTTP endpoint configuration. 2. Attempt to access the endpoint without authentication from a non-localhost address. 3. Verify that the endpoint is bound to localhost or requires authentication. 4. If accessible, enumerate what sensitive data is exposed (validator counts, sync state, peer topology). 5. Attempt to falsify the invariant: find a configuration path where the endpoint is exposed to 0.0.0.0 without auth.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-METRICS-INV-002. Invariant: metrics endpoint must only be accessible to authorized monitoring. Related assumption: ASSUM-METRICS-01. Primary element: ACTION-UPDATE-VALIDATOR-COUNTS.

checklist.title: Falsify ommer validation pre-condition: submit block with >2 ommers, duplicate ommers, or ommer age outside [1,6] range
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the ommer validation function. 2. Attempt to bypass: submit a block with 3 ommers and verify rejection. 3. Submit a block with duplicate ommer hashes and verify rejection. 4. Submit a block with ommer age=0 (same height) and verify rejection. 5. Submit a block with ommer age=7 (too old) and verify rejection. 6. Verify that ommer parent references point to ancestors in the canonical chain.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-HOMESTEAD-PRECOND-002. Pre-condition on ACTION-VALIDATE-OMMERS. Falsification: bypass ommer count/age/duplicate/parent constraints.

checklist.title: Falsify transaction execution post-conditions: verify nonce increment, gas refund formula, and receipt generation correctness
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute a transaction and verify sender nonce is exactly previous_nonce + 1. 2. Execute a transaction with SSTORE refunds and verify refund = min(gas_used/2, refund_counter). 3. Verify receipt contains correct cumulative gas used (sum of all tx gas in block up to this point). 4. Verify receipt logs bloom matches the bloom filter of emitted logs. 5. Attempt to falsify: find a code path where nonce increments by != 1 or refund exceeds gas_used/2.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-HOMESTEAD-POSTCOND-002. Post-condition on ACTION-CREATE-RECEIPT. Side-effects: nonce+1, gas refund capped, receipt with cumulative gas and bloom.

checklist.title: Falsify block reward post-condition: verify miner receives exactly 5 ETH + (5/32)*ommer_count and ommer miners receive ((8-age)*5)/8 ETH
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the block reward distribution function. 2. Verify miner reward formula: 5 ETH + (5 ETH / 32) * number_of_ommers. 3. Verify each ommer miner reward: ((8 - ommer_age) * 5 ETH) / 8. 4. Test with 0, 1, and 2 ommers at various ages (1-6) and verify exact amounts. 5. Attempt to falsify: find integer rounding errors or edge cases in reward calculation.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-HOMESTEAD-POSTCOND-004. Post-condition on ACTION-PAY-BLOCK-REWARD. Verify exact reward amounts for miner and ommer miners.

checklist.title: Falsify light client proof verification invariant: attempt proof verification without access to verified state roots
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the proof verification function for light clients. 2. Verify that it requires a verified state root as input (from consensus layer). 3. Attempt to falsify: provide an unverified or fabricated state root and check if proof verification still succeeds. 4. Verify that the state root source is authenticated (e.g., from a finalized beacon block).
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP7919-INV-001. Invariant: light clients must have verified state roots. Related assumption: ASSUM-EIP7919-01.

checklist.title: Falsify Merkle tree depth invariant: verify deposit count cannot exceed 2^32 and tree handles boundary correctly
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the progressive Merkle tree implementation (DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_TREE_DEPTH=32). 2. Verify that the deposit count is checked against 2^32 maximum. 3. Verify that attempting to insert deposit at index 2^32 is rejected or handled safely. 4. Attempt to falsify: find a code path where the count could wrap or the tree depth could be exceeded.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-DEPOSIT-INV-002. Invariant: tree supports max 2^32 deposits. Related assumption: ASSUM-DEPOSIT-02.

checklist.title: Falsify gas conservation invariant: verify gas_left + gas_consumed = initial_gas at every opcode boundary
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the gas charging function in the EVM execution loop. 2. Trace gas deductions for each opcode category and verify no gas is created or destroyed. 3. Check for gas refund handling: verify refunds are tracked separately and applied post-execution. 4. Look for opcodes that might violate conservation (e.g., CALL stipend, memory expansion). 5. Attempt to falsify: find a state where gas_left + gas_consumed != initial_gas.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-VM-INV-001. Invariant: gas_left + gas_consumed = initial_gas always. Primary element: ACTION-CHARGE-GAS.

checklist.title: Falsify EVM termination invariant: verify execution loop always terminates via gas exhaustion or explicit halt
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Trace the EVM main execution loop. 2. Verify every iteration either advances PC or triggers a halt condition. 3. Verify that gas is charged on every iteration (preventing infinite loops). 4. Check JUMP/JUMPI handling: verify PC is always updated. 5. Attempt to falsify: construct bytecode that could loop without gas consumption (e.g., PC manipulation edge cases).
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-VM-INV-002. Invariant: EVM loop must terminate. Every iteration advances PC or halts.

checklist.title: Falsify memory/stack bounds invariant: verify gas costs for memory expansion prevent host resource exhaustion
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the memory expansion gas cost formula: cost = (size^2 / 512) + 3*size. 2. Verify that memory expansion cost is charged before memory is allocated. 3. Calculate the maximum memory allocatable within block gas limit and verify host can handle it. 4. Verify stack depth is bounded at 1024. 5. Attempt to falsify: find a path where memory can grow without proportional gas charge.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-VM-INV-005. Invariant: memory/stack ops bounded by gas. Related assumption: ASSUM-VM-02.

checklist.title: Falsify jump destination validation invariant: verify valid_jump_destinations is pre-computed and immutable during init code execution
checklist.bug_class: Code Injection via Jump Table Mutation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the JUMPDEST analysis / valid_jump_destinations computation. 2. Verify it is computed once before execution begins and not modified during execution. 3. Verify JUMP/JUMPI check destinations against this pre-computed set. 4. Attempt to falsify: find a code path where self-modifying code (via MSTORE + CREATE) could affect the jump table of the current execution context.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-VM-INV-007. Invariant: jump destinations pre-computed and immutable. Related assumption: ASSUM-VM-04.

checklist.title: Falsify REVERT-during-CREATE post-condition: verify no contract code is stored and 0 is pushed to caller stack
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the CREATE/CREATE2 handler's REVERT path. 2. Verify that when init code REVERTs, no code is stored at the computed address. 3. Verify 0 is pushed to the caller's stack (not the address). 4. Verify that any state changes made during init code execution are fully reverted. 5. Attempt to falsify: find a path where partial deployment artifacts remain after REVERT.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-REVERT-POSTCOND-003. Post-condition on ACTION-ABORT-DEPLOYMENT. No code stored, 0 pushed to stack.

checklist.title: Falsify JUMP/JUMPI post-condition: verify PC is set to exact destination after JUMP, and PC increments by 1 after JUMPI with condition==0
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the JUMP opcode handler and verify PC = validated_destination. 2. Locate the JUMPI handler: verify PC = destination when condition != 0, PC = PC+1 when condition == 0. 3. Verify no off-by-one in PC update (destination must be a JUMPDEST). 4. Attempt to falsify: execute JUMPI with condition=0 and verify sequential execution continues.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-CONTROL-POSTCOND-001. Post-condition on ACTION-SET-PC-TO-DESTINATION.

checklist.title: Falsify control flow gas cost invariant: verify deterministic gas costs for PC(BASE), JUMP(MID), JUMPI(HIGH), JUMPDEST(JUMPDEST)
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the gas cost table/mapping for control flow opcodes. 2. Verify PC costs GAS_BASE, JUMP costs GAS_MID, JUMPI costs GAS_HIGH, JUMPDEST costs GAS_JUMPDEST. 3. Cross-reference with the Yellow Paper / EIP specifications. 4. Attempt to falsify: look for fork-dependent gas cost overrides that might create inconsistency.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-CONTROL-INV-002. Invariant: gas costs for control flow must be deterministic. Related assumption: ASSUM-CONTROL-FLOW-03.

checklist.title: Falsify replay protection invariant: verify chainId and nonce inclusion in dataToSign for EIP-7749 signatures
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the EIP-7749 dataToSign construction. 2. Verify chainId is included in the signed data. 3. Verify a nonce or equivalent temporal binding is included. 4. Attempt to falsify: take a valid signature from chain A and verify it is rejected on chain B. 5. Check if the specification marks these as SHOULD vs MUST and assess implementation compliance.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP7749-INV-004. Invariant: chainId and nonce SHOULD be in signed data. Related ambiguity: AMB-EIP7749-01.

checklist.title: Falsify eth/68 throttling invariant: verify transaction metadata-based throttling prevents bandwidth exhaustion
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Locate the eth/68 transaction announcement handler. 2. Verify that announced transaction sizes are used to implement throttling/rate limiting. 3. Attempt to falsify: announce transactions with large sizes and verify the node throttles fetch requests accordingly. 4. Verify that a peer announcing many large transactions does not cause unbounded bandwidth consumption.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-ETH68-INV-002. Invariant: throttling policies based on tx metadata. Related assumption: ASSUM-EIP5793-02.
